label: Surgery rate
definition_text: Proportion of all diagnosed patients who underwent surgical resection. Analysed by HHS of residence only.

label: Time to surgery
definition_text: Median and interquartile range of days from diagnosis to surgery, surgical patients only.

label: Hospital-acquired complication
definition_text: Proportion of surgical patients recording a hospital-acquired complication.

label: Prolonged length of stay (>21 days)
definition_text: Proportion of surgical patients with a post-operative length of stay exceeding 21 days.

label: 28-day unplanned readmission
definition_text: Proportion of surgical patients with an unplanned readmission within 28 days of discharge.

label: Stage at diagnosis
definition_text: Distribution of stage at diagnosis across all diagnosed patients. Analysed by HHS of residence only.
